items.question: What ritual repetition must be performed for the deity worshipped by the gods?
premises: The practice involves a locus in the mass of syllables at the forehead.
The required act consists of one hundred thousand repetitions.
The act is addressed to the deity worshipped by the gods.
items.inference: One must perform one hundred thousand repetitions situated in the forehead's syllable-mass for the god-worshipped deity.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the 'varṇa-rāśi' at the forehead is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: O deity worshipped by the gods, having performed one hundred thousand repetitions situated in the mass of syllables at the forehead.
